info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Connect Experiences-spec
info.description: The Connect Experiences Retrieval API allows users to access a curated list of connect experiences within the service. This API serves as a vital resource for applications that need to display available experiences, offering an organized and efficient way to retrieve the relevant data. Typically utilized by developers building user interfaces or client applications, this API streamlines the integration of connect experiences into various platforms. By leveraging this endpoint, consumers can effectively enhance user engagement and improve the overall experience associated with connecting services.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all available experiences from the system, providing an overview of the different options you can explore. The response includes details about each experience, such as description, duration, and availability.

requestBody.description: Request body to retrieve experiences. The body must contain valid JSON that conforms to the predefined schema for fetching experience resources.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of experiences.

ListConnectExperiencesRequest.description: A request body for the GET operation of experiences in operations. This will typically include information related to the experiences being requested.

ListConnectExperiencesResponse_200.description: Response schema for the Operations GET request, containing a list of experience items and metadata.

id.description: The unique identifier of the experience item.

appName.description: The name of the application associated with the experience item.

productCode.description: A list of product codes related to the experience item.

ExperienceItem.description: Represents an experience item with details such as identifier, application name, and product codes.

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: A correlation identifier for tracking the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The geographical region where the request was processed.

ResponseMetadata.description: Metadata regarding the response, including identifiers and timestamps.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses the Bearer authentication method. Clients must provide a valid JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header of their requests to access secure endpoints.
